content.title: MVP Rewards
content: Claim any MVP weekly rewards you may have.

content.title: Tera Blink
content: Complete Tera Blink, get 5th job.

content.title: Auto Harvest
content: Learn professions and claim your auto harvest. Start if not done today.

content.title: Start all new events
content: - Raising Ellanos
- Tallahart Fantasia (Remember to check in and put skill points in MP)
- Phantasmal Echoes
- Challenger Partners
- Challenger Pass
- Arcane Seal

content.title: Join a guild
content: Optionally do a quick culvert just in case guild points are given at reset.

content.title: 4x Strawberry Farm
content: IMPORTANT: Be careful with how much time you have. If time is short, skip the leveling sections and try to get some bosses done.
Erel and Sia can ignore this part with a paid pass.
Claim 3 Strawberry farms from check in and one from Summer Countdown. Use all 4.
Remember to use 5th job stones, when one of them is filled, exit, use the exp potion, and use the next stone.

content.title: Kill 2000 enemies
content: Complete any Arcane River dailies you are able to while doing so.
Claim 800 Illusion Coins from Raising Ellanos event.
Complete Challenger World daily check-in.
OPTIONALLY: You can log onto your main to kill 4k monsters, if you think that is a better choice.

content.title: 4x Strawberry Farm
content: Use 800 Illusion Coins to buy 4 Golden Strawberry Farm Tickets and complete them.

content.title: Weekly and Daily Bosses
content: Ideally you should try to kill enough for 750mil mesos.
- Prioritize Chaos Pink Bean, Chaos Papulatus, Princess NO and Normal Cygnus
- Princess NO for Kanna's Treasure and secondary pieces
- Normal Cygnus if you are a shield user
- Chaos Pink Bean for Pink Bean Cup and Black Bean Mark (you get a free 15* Belt from Hyper Burning MAX, but keep the belt too)
- Chaos Papulatus for Papulatus Mark

content.title: Meso Shop
content: Purchase 10x Express Booster and 30x Sealing Wand.
This should cost 750mil, but the price of Express Boosters was raised, so Sealing Wands could be more expensive as well.

content.title: Buy 3x Coupons
content: Challenger World Shop has 7x of them weekly.
If you were able to defeat Princess No or a harder boss, you can buy 7x more from Phantasmal Echoes shop.

content.title: Reward Point Shop
content: OPTIONAL!
You can use Reward Points to get 3 pet slots, 20 Monster Park Tickets, 5 Solid Cubes and 5 Bright Cubes.

content.title: 7x Monster Park
content: Run Monster Park 7 times. MAKE SURE you have time for this, skip some of the previous tasks if you do not have time.

content.title: Arcane River Weeklies
content: If you have time, complete any missing Arcane River Dailies and Weeklies.
If you have even more time, you can consider using some VIP boosters, but you'd generally want to do this before the MP runs.

content.title: Shine Pass
content: COMPLETELY OPTIONAL!!!
If you want to buy the pass and you are not maining Erel/Sia, creating either and leveling them to 200 for transferable rewards does save your main a lot of time.
Up to level 101 you can do story, after that you can use some Strawberry Farms.
DISCLAIMER: Make sure that the Shine Pass paid rewards are actually transferable before doing this!
If patch notes are correct, you should be able to move 3x Mag Pot, 10x VIP booster, 30 day vac pet and an exp title.
If you are confident that you have enough time, you can do this on day 0.

content.title: Start Threads of Fate
content: Unlock 1 NPC so you can talk to them every 30 minutes to increase Closeness.
Once you reach 50 closeness, check what you can ask them. If it's herbs, you should go unlock the second NPC asap as well.

content.title: Create a Zero
content: Assuming that you didn't create a second character yet, Zero can be created in about 30 seconds for a bit of free attack.

content.title: Meso/Drop Gear
content: If you are going to farm, start building your meso/drop gear. Summer Countdown gives resources to help with rings.
If you need another ring, NLC questline takes about 5 minutes to get you a Treasure Hunter John's Ring.
Buy Greed Pendant from Monster park and Cube a line of Item Droprate on it.

content.title: Unlock Second Familiar Slot
content: Unlock at least 1 Familiar slot, unlock the rest when you level up and get to higher areas in Grandis (those badges are much easier to obtain)
- Recommended Familiar badges that are not too hard to get
- Oppressor Badge
- Starter Badge
- Lion Badge
- Void Badge
- Labyrinth Badge
- Apocalypse Badge
- Ocean Badge
- Swamp Badge
- Holy Badge
- Wasteland Badge (needs level 265)
- Researcher Badge (needs level 275)

content.title: Reach level 260
content: This might take quite a lot of hours in limina. It is recommended to do your Monster Park runs once you reach level 255, if the alternative option is grinding.

content.title: Tera Burn a Cygnus Knight to level 150
content: - Gives you max level attack buff
- You can now delete your zero
- Make one that you dont have yet, you can transfer it to Heroic later (you can also finish the Tera Burn to 200 at some point)

content.title: Afterlands
content: Do Afterlands questline for free permanent totems
- https://www.reddit.com/r/Maplestory/comments/8fgfty/afterlands_guide_fastest_way_possible_no_bugs/
- Another alternative is doing Yu Garden questline for better totems, but they last 30 days and the droprate on the Incense Burner is VERY LOW
- You can also mix&match getting the 2 easier ones from Yu Garden, and then use one Afterlands totem of your main stat as the 3rd one!
